title: When Graph Autoencoders Look the Wrong Way: Complexity Bias and Simple Baselines in Unsupervised Anomaly Detection on the LHC Olympics 2020 Dataset (preprint and code)
description: Preprint and full code. Graph autoencoders trained on background-only events of the LHC Olympics 2020 R&D dataset give inverted anomaly scores (AUC 0.40-0.44), while the label-free mean transverse momentum per particle (HT/N) reaches AUC 0.811. Correlation and within-bin analyses link the inversion of the latent-density scores to event complexity. The paper is in paper/main.pdf. Trained checkpoints and per-event test scores: https://huggingface.co/Viverun/lhco-rnd-event-gae.
